comments.author: hiddenyak
comments.body_html:
Hello acidphantasm,

I think this is a great mod but I have one critique.

The goal of this type of mod is to enable the user to quickly identify the value of an item. I am aware that this mod leverages the handbook price. My issue is that this handbook price does not accurately reflect what the optimal trader will pay for a given item.

Example: SJ6 has a per slot guide price of ~ 190k, but it sells to therapist (best trader for this) for 19k.

Is there any way to have the coloring be based off the sell price of the item?

As is, looting strictly based off background color (with or without flea banned color disabled) will not result in the most valuable items.

I supposed this is impossible either way, because the color needs to be set when the spt server starts, and things like armor and weapons could have dynamic value. I am interested in your thoughts on this matter.

Thanks for your hard work!

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
Everything is based off flea prices right now and nothing to do with traders.

There is a feature request for trader prices but this mod does not have that at this time.

If you use Live Flea Prices, the background colours refresh as needed based on the new price. If you don’t then it’s only set at server start.

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
If you use colour converter API then you can adjust the colours for the ones you want to be “hidden” to a dark greyish colour hex code and that should allow you do to do what want.

If you don’t use color converter, there is no way at this time.

comments.author: hachdale
comments.body_html:
Hi acidphantasm,

Thank you for making this mod!

I’m using 3.11 and noticed some item prices list differently in their context menus compared to how much traders will actually buy them for.

For example, starting M4A1 is listed as 35,947 (@ Mechanic) but Mechanic is actually buying for 38,970. The discrepancy can be even smaller, for example, propital reg stim is listed as 13,268 (@ Therapist) but Therapist is actually buying for 13,267.

Side question: is it possible to toggle off those prices from the context menu all together?

Appreciate you for all your hard work!

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
The description trader price is based on the lowest loyalty level, because the server has no idea what loyalty level you are when it is started because your client hasn’t launched. For cases where it’s off by 1 is because of rounding.

At this time there is no toggle to disable it.

comments.author: hachdale
comments.body_html: That makes so much sense. Thanks for your response!
